messages.subject: Executive Candidate Introduction | ESG, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Venkateswaran,

I am reaching out directly because the published CEO Search India candidate route returned as undeliverable and the website contact form is currently failing. I would be grateful if you would consider my profile for suitable senior international mandates or route it to the appropriate colleague.

I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with more than 12 years across multinational mining, regulated banking and commercial operations. My leadership scope spans ESG and social responsibility, government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination, executive communications and cross-functional operating delivery.

I hold an MBA and BSc in Business Administration. I am internationally mobile with a 30-day notice period and am targeting Director, Head and Country-level opportunities across ESG and sustainability, corporate and external affairs, government relations, strategic partnerships, business development and country operations. My geographic priorities include Saudi Arabia, the UAE and wider international markets.

I have attached my executive CV for review. Given CEO Search India's focus on senior and board-level appointments, I would welcome a confidential conversation regarding mandates where my institutional, stakeholder and natural-resources experience would add value.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
